verdict.rationale: Ente ships an official CLI that the Auth docs point to for automated backups. A runtime probe confirms it is packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli 0.3.0, but its documented scope is limited to exporting data and decrypting Auth exports, not general code management or retrieval. missing for 10: CLI commands for listing, generating or managing 2FA codes, in-depth CLI documentation in the evidence, agent-oriented usage guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
Ente's official CLI is packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli 0.3.0, described by the formula itself as 'Utility for exporting data from Ente and decrypt the export from Ente Auth'
This means you can go ahead and script a workflow that works for you.
